name: GlobalEventProps
description: React-only event handler props for kits that opt into GlobalEventProps. Separate from class-based GlobalProps. Not available on Rails kits.

onClick.description: Mouse click handler attached to the kit root element. React only; not available on Rails kits.

optIn.description: Only kits whose React props include GlobalEventProps support these handlers. Look for globalEventProps: true on kit.schema.json.
